mapper.select: SELECT id, request_id, call_id, user_id, account_id, session_id, agent_id, model_id, provider_code, model_name, model_revision, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_tokens, reasoning_tokens, actual_tokens, charged_tokens, reserved_tokens, input_weight, output_weight, cache_weight, reasoning_weight, estimated_cost, usage_source, usage_unit, usage_quantity, measurement_quality, status, error_code, error_message, start_time, finish_time, create_dept, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM token_usage WHERE call_id = #{callId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, request_id, call_id, user_id, account_id, session_id, agent_id, model_id, provider_code, model_name, model_revision, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_tokens, reasoning_tokens, actual_tokens, charged_tokens, reserved_tokens, estimated_cost, usage_source, usage_unit, usage_quantity, measurement_quality, status, error_code, error_message, start_time, finish_time, create_dept, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM token_usage
ORDER BY start_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCalls, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successCalls, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failedCalls, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS outputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(actual_tokens), 0) AS actualTokens, COALESCE(SUM(charged_tokens), 0) AS chargedTokens, COALESCE(SUM(estimated_cost), 0) AS estimatedCost FROM token_usage

SELECT CAST(model_id AS CHAR) AS `key`, MAX(model_name) AS name, COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(actual_tokens), 0) AS actualTokens, COALESCE(SUM(charged_tokens), 0) AS chargedTokens FROM token_usage
GROUP BY model_id ORDER BY SUM(charged_tokens) DESC, model_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT CAST(user_id AS CHAR) AS `key`, COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(actual_tokens), 0) AS actualTokens, COALESCE(SUM(charged_tokens), 0) AS chargedTokens FROM token_usage
GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY SUM(charged_tokens) DESC, user_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE(start_time) AS `key`, COUNT(*) AS calls, COALESCE(SUM(actual_tokens), 0) AS actualTokens, COALESCE(SUM(charged_tokens), 0) AS chargedTokens FROM token_usage
GROUP BY DATE(start_time) ORDER BY `key` ASC
